description: This file defines the LinkRenderer class responsible for rendering and processing Markdown link nodes, handling URL validation, external/internal link resolution, and error handling within a Markdown content rendering system.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders Markdown link nodes, resolving URLs, handling external and internal links, and managing broken links within the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LinkRenderer with a Daux Config object and sets up the parent LinkRenderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes a Markdown link node, validates and resolves its URL, adds appropriate attributes for external or broken links, and returns the rendered element.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the parent LinkRenderer.
